description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril’s Demand & Supply Planning team is seeking a world-class Demand & Supply Planner to join our team. The Demand & Supply Planner has an integral role at Anduril, having material flow responsibility throughout the entire value chain, from raw materials to finished goods shipped to customers. They will have full ownership of certain assemblies and product lines, and will be ultimately responsible for sending the correct signals to Purchasing and Manufacturing on what and when to buy or build. This hire will be instrumental in signaling and forecasting accurate demand, planning inventory levels, and ensuring that Anduril supports its hardware requirements via Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software and other associated tools.

The right person for this role has demonstrate ownership and experience solving complex operational challenges with creative solutions in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. • Manage day-to-day demand signaling, ordering, and inventory for various product lines.

• Identify and resolve supply issues by collaborating with Engineering, Purchasing, and Manufacturing teams.

• Lead Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) discussions for Supply Planning on designated product lines.

• Work with Business Development and Growth teams to align forecasts with actual demand plans.

• Report on and analyze supply and material health to inform key decisions for Engineering, Purchasing, Manufacturing, and Business Development.

• Develop and maintain processes within MRP systems and associated master data.

• Drive strategic initiatives towards best practices, including demand shaping, advanced modeling, and inventory optimization.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (i.e. manufacturing, engineering, analytics, computer science, etc.) or business field (i.e. finance, economics, supply chain management, business administration, marketing, etc.)

• 3+ years of experience in a supply chain or production role within a fast-paced manufacturing environment dealing with complex assemblies.

• Complete ownership of a complex value chain, coordinating between multiple, high volume of departments and teams to ensure on-time deliveries and adherence to quality standards.

• Technical expertise including ability to read technical documentation and understanding hardware manufacturing processes.

• Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle, NetSuite, and CRM systems like Salesforce.

• Ability to travel up to 10% of the time.

• Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Costa Mesa, CA.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Master’s degree or other higher education.

• Strong experience with SQL databases, including building custom queries for production and inventory metrics.

• Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Qlikview.

• Knowledge of supply chain planning systems like Blue Yonder and best practices in demand planning, inventory management, and S&OP.

title: Director, Supply Chain
description:
Builds and leads Ezurio 's end-to-end supply chain function, reporting to the COO and leading supply chain teams across the modules business and SOM and SBC Business. Turns execution into a documented, system-driven function spanning SIOP, systems and process, purchasing, inventory, and category management and sourcing, as measured by on-time delivery, clear-to-build performance, forecast accuracy, inventory and working capital targets, and cost savings. RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SIOP) end to end, including inputs, forecast modeling, safety stock, and risk-buy decisions; a tiered cadence of demand review, supply review, and executive reconciliation; and reconciliation of the sales forecast against the statistical forecast and to the revenue and margin plan.

• Plan capacity and flag constraints 50+ weeks out.

• Document what the supply chain organization does, company-wide, hold the organization to the documented process, and run internal process audits that feed back into process and system updates.

• Act as the supply chain systems architect: define ERP input and output requirements and the interaction with PLM and CRM and drive the toolset to match the designed process.

• Define supply chain SOPs for release through the Quality Management System (QMS), in partnership with Quality.

• Own purchasing and vendor risk management, including the approved vendor list (AVL).

• Drive vendor consolidation and automate purchasing workflows through MRP in the ERP.

• Own working capital targets, inventory control, excess and obsolete (E&O) policy, clear-to-build, and risk-buy and spot-buy policy across the network, including where inventory is held and purchase price variance (PPV).

• Build system controls and on-demand dashboards that manage inventory KPIs and risk.

• Lead sourcing strategy and category management, supplier scorecards, on-time delivery and lead-time visibility, and contract and terms management (MSAs and SLAs).

• Build dedicated category management and sourcing engineering capability within a lean organization.

• Own supply chain risk strategy, including geopolitical and tariff exposure, dual-sourcing, and the make-to-stock, make-to-order, and procure-to-forecast framework.

• Establish and monitor core KPIs (on-time delivery, clear-to-build on-time performance, forecast accuracy, inventory turns, working capital, E&O dollars, stockout frequency, vendor scorecards, PPV, and cost savings.

• Define roles, responsibilities, and coverage across the function, lead and develop the team through coaching, performance management, and succession planning.

REQUIREMENTS

• Electronics industry experience is required, in electronics, semiconductor, or closely adjacent high-complexity component manufacturing.

• Demonstrated experience owning SIOP/S&OP end to end.

• Demonstrated experience defining ERP requirements and architecting supply chain processes in an ERP-driven environment; NetSuite experience is a plus.

• Strong background in inventory management, including working capital reduction, E&O control, safety stock, and risk-buy policy.

• Purchasing and procurement leadership experience, including vendor management, AVL governance, and sourcing strategy; experience building or scaling category management capability is a plus.

• Experience managing long lead-time, high component-risk supply chains.

• Experience operating at scale.

• Experience leading distributed, multi-site teams, including manager-level direct reports.

• Comfort operating in a lean, private-equity-owned environment, building scalable systems while controlling cost and headcount.

• Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience presenting to executive leadership and the board.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About Us

Trase is the operating system for high-stakes environments, providing end-to-end solutions for deploying, managing, and optimizing AI within industries where security, governance, and data sovereignty are non-negotiable.

Our HIPAA- and SOC 2-compliant platform bridges the “last mile” of AI adoption, empowering sectors like healthcare and national security to run trustworthy, predictable AI agents across any model or environment-whether in the cloud, on-prem, or at the edge-with unified policy enforcement, continuous monitoring, and fully immutable audit trails.

Trase’s suite of products includes Origin, its agentic operating system; Leagues, its marketplace for specialized, configurable, ready-to-deploy agents; and Arena, where developers build, evaluate, and package the agents that run on Origin. The company has repeatedly topped Hugging Face’s GAIA Leaderboard for Generalized AI Assistants, placing it firmly at the forefront of AI-agent innovation.

About the Role
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Trase, you’ll build and deploy AI agents and applications that solve real customer problems using Trase OS. You’ll join Leagues, our industry verticals team, supporting customers in healthcare, state and local government and education (SLED), financial services, or retail. Your focus may be one or more of these verticals; experience in all four is not required.
This is a hands-on software engineering role with direct customer ownership. You’ll work with users to understand their workflows, turn unclear requirements into technical plans, and take solutions from prototype through production. You’ll partner closely with Product, ML, and the Origin and Arena engineering teams to build on Trase OS and feed customer needs back into the platform.
We are hiring at Mid, Senior and Staff levels. Level will reflect your demonstrated engineering depth, independence, and scope of ownership.
Why This Role is Needed
Customer value depends on how well AI works within existing systems, data, and day-to-day operations. Leagues connects Trase OS to those environments and turns platform capabilities into solutions customers can use and trust.
This role exists to:

• Deliver working solutions that improve customer workflows and produce measurable outcomes.

• Bridge customer needs and platform engineering, identifying gaps early and shaping practical solutions.

• Turn successful deployments into reusable integrations and patterns that help future customers launch faster.

What makes this role challenging

• Customer environments vary in data quality, integration options, security requirements, and operational readiness.

• AI behavior must be evaluated against real workflows, including failure cases, escalation paths, and human review.

• You must balance delivery speed with reliability and maintainability, while deciding what belongs in a customer solution versus the shared platform.

Responsibilities

• Work directly with customers to map workflows, identify useful AI applications, and agree on scope, success measures, and acceptance criteria.

• Build production-quality agents, applications, APIs, and integrations using Trase OS, including backend services and user interfaces as needed.

• Integrate customer systems, data sources, and identity providers; work with infrastructure engineers to deploy in customer or Trase-managed environments.

• Own delivery through testing, deployment, customer validation, and operational handoff. Surface dependencies, risks, and scope changes early.

• Build evaluations, automated tests, observability, and human review or escalation into agent workflows; validate quality, latency, cost, and reliability.

• Apply appropriate access controls, data-handling policies, and audit logging in partnership with Security and customer teams.

• Debug production issues across application, data, integration, and infrastructure layers; document solutions and create practical runbooks.

• Contribute reusable components

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning-courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
